stories.title: Create Aesthetic Services Knowledge Assessment Suite with Bilingual Answer Schemes
stories.description: Build comprehensive Knowledge Assessment (KA) documents for all 4 Aesthetic Services CUs (C01-C04) with bilingual questions, detailed answer schemes, and competency-based rubrics. Ensures assessment quality and complete coverage of CU-level learning outcomes aligned with Buku Panduan WIM Edisi 2020.
acceptanceCriteria: KA.md created for all 4 Aesthetic CUs (C01, C02, C03, C04) with minimum 5 questions per CU in mixed formats: MCQ 40%, short answer 30%, scenario-based 30%
Each KA document includes bilingual question text (EN/BM), comprehensive answer schemes with 4-point marking rubrics (0-3 scale), and alignment to CoCU Assessment Criteria
All technical terms in KA documents are validated against aesthetic-services/_docs/aesthetic-glossary.md for consistency and bilingual coverage
technicalNotes: File to create: tools/validate_aesthetic_ka.py (validates KA format, bilingual terms, question count)
Files to modify: aesthetic-services/CU-C01/KA.md, aesthetic-services/CU-C02/KA.md, aesthetic-services/CU-C03/KA.md, aesthetic-services/CU-C04/KA.md
Test command: uv run python tools/validate_aesthetic_ka.py aesthetic-services/CU-*/KA.md --min-questions 5 --validate-bilingual

stories.title: Implement IT Level 3 Knowledge Assessment with Competency-Based Rubrics
stories.description: Create Knowledge Assessment (KA) documents for IT-020-3:2013 Level 3 mandatory CUs with varied question formats (MCQ, short answer, scenario-based) and competency rubrics. Validates all questions against NOSS Related Knowledge extraction to ensure complete curriculum coverage.
acceptanceCriteria: KA.md documents created for minimum 3 mandatory Level 3 CUs (IT-020-3) with 4-6 questions each; each question includes: learning outcome reference, difficulty level (L1/L2/L3), 4-point competency rubric (0-3), and mark allocation
Question formats distributed: 40% MCQ (4 options), 40% short answer (with model answer), 20% scenario-based with rubric guidance
All questions validated against it-computer-system/00-noss-extract.md to confirm every NOSS Related Knowledge item has minimum 1 corresponding assessment question
technicalNotes: File to create: tools/validate_it_ka.py and tools/it_noss_mapping.yaml
Files to modify: it-computer-system/L3-CU-01/KA.md, it-computer-system/L3-CU-02/KA.md, it-computer-system/L3-CU-03/KA.md
Test command: uv run python tools/validate_it_ka.py it-computer-system/L3-CU-*/KA.md --validate-against-noss --min-questions 4

stories.title: Build WIM Coverage Validator for NOSS-to-Document Requirement Traceability
stories.description: Develop automated coverage validator that parses NOSS extracts (00-noss-extract.md) against WIM documents (KP, KK) to generate traceability matrix and coverage report. Identifies gaps in curriculum coverage and provides gap-closure recommendations aligned with Buku Panduan WIM standards.
acceptanceCriteria: CLI tool: tools/coverage_validator.py accepts --subject flag (bev/aesthetic/it) and generates output/coverage_report_[subject].md with coverage statistics: % Related Knowledge covered by KP, % Work Activities covered by KK, list of uncovered NOSS items
Validator output includes: coverage matrix table, gap analysis with recommendations, cross-references to specific WIM document chapters for each mapped requirement
Coverage report validates against NOSS CoCU structure: confirms every 'Related Knowledge' item has >=1 KP reference, every 'Work Activity' has >=1 KK reference
technicalNotes: File to create: tools/coverage_validator.py (~180 lines), tools/noss_parser.py (utility module)
Test command: uv run pytest tests/test_coverage_validator.py::test_bev_coverage -v; uv run python tools/coverage_validator.py --subject bev --output output/coverage_report_bev.md
